status: root-proposed named-case candidate; not a user-selected project-wide target

case.model: WRF test/em_b_wave, dry and flat, 16x16x16, final time 240 s; dx=dy=100 km
case.source_config: All three use one-rank/one-thread standard Fortran RK3, scheme=0/rk_ord=3, same input SHA; namelist diffs only timestep fields. Executable hashes differ for h7.5 versus the two finer runs, but the post-fix source change is on the C++/SDIRK bridge path, RK3 actual_cpp_sdirk_route=false, and post-fix closure proves pre/post h3.75 RK3 fields bitwise equal at all five output times.

sampling.U: m/s; unique periodic X faces only
sampling.V: m/s; both physical Y walls included
sampling.W: m/s; fixed lower W face excluded, top included
sampling.PH: height Z=(PH+PHB)/g in m; fixed lower face excluded, top included
sampling.T: physical potential temperature T+300 K; all mass points
sampling.MU: total dry column mass MU+MUB in Pa; all mass points

budget_definition: epsilon_X=max(0.01*RMS(reference_X(240)-reference_X(0)),3*q_X(240)); fixed numeric epsilon is applied at all four evaluation times. q is raw reference FP32 perturbation-output spacing, not internal arithmetic uncertainty. No candidate-derived floor or post-result relaxation.

U.units: m/s; unique periodic X faces only

V.units: m/s; both physical Y walls included

W.units: m/s; fixed lower W face excluded, top included

PH.units: m^2/s^2 geopotential; PH perturbation, fixed lower face excluded, top included

T.units: physical potential temperature T+300 K; all mass points

MU.units: total dry column mass MU+MUB in Pa; all mass points

reference_qualification.gate: One RK3 h=0.9375 run vs archived h=1.875: per-field RMS change at every checkpoint <= fixed epsilon_X/3; all physical admissibility and boundary invariants pass.
reference_qualification.status: unqualified; run not performed at freeze
reference_qualification.meaning: observed resolution sensitivity only, not exact-solution error bound or measured order
reference_qualification.run_limit: one new refinement; failure stops qualification and does not authorize an unbounded ladder

candidate_accuracy.gate: Only after reference qualification, candidate vs h=1.875 per-field RMS <= fixed epsilon_X at every evaluation time; no aggregate cross-unit norm
candidate_accuracy.timing: No fixed-operator 240-s run has occurred at freeze

requirements: All physical input states and auxiliary context equal before subtraction
Independent primitive term oracle at every owned boundary, including west U face
Exact periodic output aliases, symmetric V wall and fixed lower W invariants
First-order directional derivative and periodic translation tests for changed stress path
Record remaining complete-RHS discrepancy separately; do not certify all spatial equations from corrected U terms
operator_gate.roundoff_limits: gamma_n*sum|terms| only bounds accumulation of already computed terms; it is not a bound on all primitive operations or full cross-model RHS. Oracle test tolerance must account for its own expression DAG and exported representation.

integrated_derivatives: Existing supported fixture budgets remain valid; no broader observation-window VJP/JVP gate closed here
versioning: Changing scope or budgets creates a new contract version; it never revokes closed rotating-wave validation.
